# Get collection and document IDs

Retrieve the IDs of a <Term id="supporting-documents">supporting document</Term> collection and its documents: the inputs most document operations require.

## Get a collection ID {#get-collection-id}

Get the ID for the supporting document collection using either the user's onboarding ID or, if their onboarding is `Finalized`, their <Term id="account-holder">account holder</Term> ID.

<Tabs>
<TabItem value="onboardingId" label="Onboarding ID">

### Get a collection ID with the onboarding ID {#get-collection-id-onboarding}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {2} showLineNumbers
query getCollectionId {
  accountHolderOnboarding(id: "$USER_ONBOARDING_ID") {
    ... on IndividualAccountHolderOnboarding {
      supportingDocumentCollection {
        id
        requiredSupportingDocumentPurposes {
          name
        }
        statusInfo {
          status
        }
      }
    }
    ... on CompanyAccountHolderOnboarding {
      supportingDocumentCollection {
        id
        requiredSupportingDocumentPurposes {
          name
        }
        statusInfo {
          status
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="accountHolderId" label="Account holder ID">

### Get a collection ID with the account holder ID {#get-collection-id-account-holder}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {2,9} showLineNumbers
query getCollectionId {
  accountHolder(id: "$USER_ACCOUNT_HOLDER_ID") {
    supportingDocumentCollections {
      edges {
        node {
          requiredSupportingDocumentPurposes {
            name
          }
          id
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Get a document ID {#get-document-id}

Get the ID for the supporting document using either the user's onboarding ID or, if their onboarding is `Finalized`, their account holder ID.

<Tabs>
<TabItem value="onboardingId" label="Onboarding ID">

### Get a document ID with the onboarding ID {#get-document-id-onboarding}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {2} showLineNumbers
query getDocumentId {
  accountHolderOnboarding(id: "$USER_ONBOARDING_ID") {
    ... on IndividualAccountHolderOnboarding {
      supportingDocumentCollection {
        supportingDocuments {
          id
          statusInfo {
            status
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ... on CompanyAccountHolderOnboarding {
      supportingDocumentCollection {
        supportingDocuments {
          id
          statusInfo {
            status
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="accountHolderId" label="Account holder ID">

### Get a document ID with the account holder ID {#get-document-id-account-holder}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {2} showLineNumbers
query getDocumentId {
  accountHolder(id: "$USER_ACCOUNT_HOLDER_ID") {
    supportingDocumentCollections {
      edges {
        node {
          supportingDocuments {
            id
            statusInfo {
              status
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>
